title: Kissed Slovakian Chicken Stew
description: A funky and comforting Slovakian dish featuring rosemary and chicken, cooked to perfection in a clay pot and wrapped in pandan leaves, making it a whole30 friendly meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
In a large clay pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and chopped celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chicken thighs to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped carrots, rosemary sprigs, and chicken broth to the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Wrap the pandan leaves around the pot to infuse the stew with flavor and aroma.
